title: Giant Chocolate Chip Cookies

paragraphs: Gather your ingredients before you start baking. The larger the cookie, the more care you need.
Melt the butter and sugars. Mix in the dry ingredients. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Portion the dough onto a baking sheet. Bake at 350°F for 10–12 minutes.
Let the cookies cool on the sheet before transferring them to a wire rack.

blocks.label: Tip
blocks.text: For extra chew, let the cookies cool in the oven before removing them from the sheet.
